meta.note: prices tagged live-fred are current; assessed-seed are researched baselines.

prices.name: Lithium carbonate
prices.chemistry_key_fact: Li2CO3 · 99.5% min. Battery-grade threshold; hydroxide route (LiOH·H2O) preferred for high-nickel cathodes.
prices.economic_note: More than doubled from the Jun-2025 ~$8,100/t trough on supply discipline and EV/storage demand. IEA: prices >2x year-ago.

prices.name: Lithium hydroxide
prices.chemistry_key_fact: LiOH·H2O; required for NMC/NCA high-nickel cathodes (low calcination temp, no Li2O loss).
prices.economic_note: Tracks carbonate with a grade premium; supply constrained by conversion capacity outside China.

prices.name: Cobalt
prices.chemistry_key_fact: Co metal 99.8%; sulfate CoSO4·7H2O is the battery intermediate; DRC quota system tightens supply.
prices.economic_note: Recovered from ~$24,300/t (2025) on DRC export quota tightening; CME reports >$25/lb intra-2026. Wide reporting range — treat with caution.

prices.name: Nickel
prices.chemistry_key_fact: Class I (>99.8% Ni) for NMC cathodes; HPAL laterite route (Ni0.8Co0.1Mn0.1(OH)2 precursor).
prices.economic_note: Indonesian laterite oversupply caps prices; Western Class I premium persists for battery use.

prices.name: Copper
prices.chemistry_key_fact: Cu cathode 99.99% (Grade A); 60-70 kg per EV; data-centre and grid demand compounding.
prices.economic_note: Structural deficit consensus (2025-2028); UBS AI/grid thesis cites ~$14,000/t by Sep-2026.

prices.name: Aluminium
prices.chemistry_key_fact: Primary Al via Bayer+Halls-Heroult; 13-16 MWh/t embodied energy — power cost is the price floor.
prices.economic_note: Grid/electrification demand vs Chinese smelting cap; scrap/EAF adjacency for construction materials.

prices.name: Zinc
prices.chemistry_key_fact: Zn 99.995% SHG; galvanising = ~50% of demand; also in zinc-air storage R&D.
prices.economic_note: Construction/steel adjacency; mine closures tightening concentrate supply.

prices.name: Lead
prices.chemistry_key_fact: Pb 99.97%; lead-acid dominance in ESS backup and automotive; 90%+ recycling rate.
prices.economic_note: Stationary storage backup + grid resilience driving secondary Pb demand.

prices.name: Tin
prices.chemistry_key_fact: Sn 99.85%; solders for semiconductors; Myanmar/Indonesia supply concentration.
prices.economic_note: Semiconductor + AI hardware demand; low exchange inventories.

prices.name: Uranium (U3O8)
prices.chemistry_key_fact: U3O8; enrichment to UO2 fuel; SMR/gigawatt-scale buildout extends demand curve.
prices.economic_note: Supply squeeze narrative intact; long-term contracting underpins price floor.

prices.name: Graphite (natural, battery-grade)
prices.chemistry_key_fact: Spherical coated graphite 99.95%C anode; China ~90% of spherical processing.
prices.economic_note: Anode demand growth with EV + ESS; China export-control licensing risk premium.

prices.name: Manganese sulphate
prices.chemistry_key_fact: MnSO4·H2O for LMFP/NMC; China ~95% of battery-grade Mn processing.
prices.economic_note: LMFP adoption lifts demand; processing bottleneck outside China.

prices.name: Neodymium-praseodymium oxide
prices.chemistry_key_fact: Nd2O3/Pr6O11 feed for Nd-Fe-B magnets; administered pricing — not a free-market LME-type price.
prices.economic_note: China domestic vs ex-China dual price regime; magnet demand (EV/wind/defence) structural.

prices.name: Dysprosium oxide
prices.chemistry_key_fact: Dy2O3; ~6.9x China/ex-China multiple (Jul-2026); indispensable for high-temp magnet coercivity.
prices.economic_note: DUAL PRICE: China domestic ~$520k/t vs ex-China ~$3.6M/t. ITAR/NDAA 2027 deadline drives Western premium.

prices.name: Gallium
prices.chemistry_key_fact: Ga 99.99%; GaAs/GaN semiconductors; by-product of alumina refining (no dedicated mines).
prices.economic_note: 2023 export controls reshaped pricing; Chinese quota + foreign-origin licensing.

prices.name: Germanium
prices.chemistry_key_fact: Ge 99.999%; infrared optics, fibre, PV; by-product of zinc/coal fly-ash.
prices.economic_note: Chinese export licensing; defence/IR demand supports premium.
